title: The Flywheel Harmonic Wobble
logline: A foundry station's kinetic flywheel develops a catastrophic harmonic wobble because the night-shift machinist used uncertified asteroid slag to cast replacement balance pins after supply delays.

roles.description: A tired lathe operator who improvised a repair to keep the foundry spinning and avoid docked wages.
A ruthless operations chief who threatens to fire the entire shift if the station drops below spin-gravity.
A fifty-meter spinning tungsten counterweight maintaining artificial gravity and power for the station core.
A scorching industrial slipway where magnetic molds shape structural station girders.
A high-temperature processing plant at the station hub where raw ore is refined into pure structural alloys.

public_situation: Vibration alarms rattle the residential decks of the foundry station in {system} as engineers announce urgent gyro-rotor balancing drills.
private_truth: The main kinetic flywheel is shearing its housing because the night machinist cast replacement balance pins from uncertified asteroid slag to meet quota after parts failed to arrive.

beats.public_change: Low-frequency rumbles shake station deckplates while maintenance drones swarm the central spindle access sleeve.

missions.reason: She needs an independent pilot to mine cuprite ore from the inner asteroid belt to cast genuine thermal damper bushings before the spindle shears off.
missions.private_fact: If she files an official requisition for materials, the automated ledger will log that she used scrap slag for the previous repair.

beats.public_change: Spin-gravity begins fluctuating erratically across the habitat rim, causing tools and furniture to slide across decks.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to collect an emergency magnetic clamp assembly from the casting berth to physically lock the vibrating spindle.
missions.private_fact: He knows the night shift cut corners, but reporting the structural flaw would void his quarterly productivity dividend.

beats.public_change: Structural warning beacons flash amber throughout the station hub as the flywheel's harmonic resonance peaks.

missions.reason: He hires an outside pilot to run an ultrasonic structural scan along the spindle collar to determine whether the shaft can survive another shift.
missions.private_fact: The scan will immediately detect the porous scrap slag pins, giving him legal cause to shift all financial liability onto the machinist.

player_choice.prompt: With the scan data in hand and the flywheel groaning under torque, the pilot must decide whether to save the machinist, protect the station, or force an evacuation.

options.label: Deliver the cuprite bushings and assist the machinist in quietly replacing the pins
Hand the scan proof of slag pins to the superintendent and let him assign the blame
Broadcast the microfracture scan directly to station life support to trigger shutdown

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot assists the machinist in installing the pure alloy bushings during a scheduled power dip.
resolutions.summary: The new bushings seat smoothly and the harmonic vibration fades. {role:night_machinist} keeps her job, while the station avoids a catastrophic structural spin collapse.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot delivered precision ore to repin a wobbling kinetic flywheel before the station broke apart.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot turns the microfracture scan over to the superintendent.
resolutions.summary: {role:foundry_superintendent} terminates {role:night_machinist} and seizes her wages to pay for repairs, preserving his own executive bonus intact.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot uncovered illicit slag repairs on a foundry rotor, resulting in a machinist's dismissal.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the scan, forcing an automated emergency scram.
resolutions.summary: Automated safety interlocks scram the flywheel. Spin-gravity is lost and the foundry is shuttered for a two-month overhaul, sparing lives but idling three hundred workers.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broadcast rotor failure data, forcing a total emergency shutdown of a regional foundry.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never gets involved or abandons the scan.
resolutions.summary: The slag pins shear under centripetal strain. The flywheel tears through the magnetic collar, wrecking the station's primary power generation.

loose_threads.detail: The shipping docket for the delayed balance pins shows the order was canceled by an offshore logistics holding firm three weeks prior.
The flywheel shaft casing bears an ultrasonic inspection stamp certifying it for twenty years past its designed operational lifespan.

radio_hooks: Foundry station operators report minor rotational calibration adjustments in {system}.
Industrial cast girder deliveries delayed amid routine plant maintenance schedule.
Workers union demands independent inspection of outer ring artificial gravity turbines.

voice_direction.night_machinist: Raspy, underslept, and speaks in rapid defensive bursts. Constantly wipes machine oil from her hands and avoids eye contact.
voice_direction.foundry_superintendent: Brisk, domineering, and relies on corporate productivity buzzwords. Becomes venomous whenever equipment maintenance costs are raised.
